name: Switch
summary: A binary setting that takes effect at once, at three sizes, with an optional description and the label before or after the track. Not for choices applied by a Save button (use Checkbox) or for actions (use Button).
a11y: `button[role=switch]` with `aria-checked`; the label inside names it, and the whole row is the target. Pending (owner F9): the knob moves to the side being saved and its own edge becomes the spinner, the one Progress arc turning around it (still under reduced motion), on a neutral track; the same focused element stays, locked with `aria-disabled` and `aria-busy`, and `aria-checked` keeps the stored value until confirmed. The arc is the accent, 3:1 on the surfaces in every context. A failure restores the stored value and offers Retry in a polite status line linked to the switch.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the setting, never its state: "More contrast", not "Turn on more contrast".

props.name: onChange
props.description: Stores the new value. Return a promise for a save; reject it when the save fails.

props.name: description
props.description: One short line under the label: what turning it on does.

props.name: size
props.description: xs (32 × 16 px track, 24 px row) for a dense panel's row, such as a layer's visibility in a design tool's inspector (the written dense-surface exception); s (32 × 20 px track, 36 px row) for dense settings lists; normal (40 × 24, 44) by default; l (56 × 32, 48) for touch-first settings.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description: `end` (default): the label after the track. `start`: the label first and the track at the row's end, filling its container, as in a settings list.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hides the visible label where the row already says what the switch is (a setting beside its row's heading). It still names the switch.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The setting can't change here. Prefer explaining why nearby.

props.name: failedText
props.description: What happened and what was kept, when a save fails. Defaults to naming the setting and its stored value.
